method_note: V4 separates OPPORTUNITY (asset selection) from ENTRY (timing), adds 90d daily trend/relative-strength context, 7d persistent watch, re-entry logic and 7d/30d winner audit. Operational adaptive entry rescue promotes persistent-watch, accelerating, emerging-mover and fast-rank-improvement markets into same-cycle enrichment; frozen V4 scoring and entry thresholds are unchanged.
